I replied to Ilse in our DM. I said I'll keep the possible Bay 35 move for the Tansley depot between us, and that if it's confirmed and they want it shared, they should tell me where.

I didn't post it, repeat it or save it anywhere. That includes GBrain: its results reach every source the brain can read, so saving it there could let it reach other members. I only searched GBrain for background. The single match was the September 2025 Tansley carrier API outage incident channel, and it says nothing about a site change.
